answer.summary: Backend compile fails in openaev-es8-client because Maven cannot resolve co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:8.19.25, the version this renovate PR bumps in pom.xml. Central and jboss both report it missing, and a repository prefix filter also blocks it. The version is likely absent or unavailable, so a rerun will probably fail the same way. If Maven Central is only lagging a fresh release, a retry could pass, so verify the version exists in Central.
